issuing_body: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Expert Group on How AI Principles Should be Implemented (AI Governance Guidelines Working Group)
implementation_notes: Non-binding, voluntary governance guidelines (Ver. 1.0) issued as a living document under METI's Agile Governance framework to operationalize Japan's 2019 Social Principles of Human-centric AI. Applies horizontally to machine-learning-based AI systems (and other decision-making systems with low visibility) across developers, operators, and data providers. Structures voluntary AI management systems around six iterative phases (conditions and risks analysis, goal setting, system design, implementation, evaluation, and re-analysis) supported by Action Targets, practical examples, and an optional gap-analysis tool. Explicitly clarifies that following the Guidelines does not guarantee compliance with applicable laws and carries no legal compulsion or safe harbor.
